reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 03 and native source-note crop, complete unchanged external-02 2048x2048 raw RGBA, native raw face/collar and note crops, the complete existing white/cyan/alpha repair sheet and its evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; specifically verified exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows, mostly blank lower paper, fine upper-lip-only hair, round spectacles, collar fit and genuine transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The repair preserves short gray hair with a high receding hairline, gray eyebrows and two thin round metal spectacle rims joined by one bridge. Fine gray hair remains limited to the upper lip with no added chin or jaw hair, and there is one serious closed mouth. The near-frontal head and shoulders, direct gaze through the spectacles, chest-up crop and soft directional light are retained. One dark navy suit, white pointed shirt collar and one dark tie remain; the collar fits directly beneath the rounded chin through a short broad transition without a stalk, pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque cool blue-gray photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note and small dark right-edge tab remain. Native source-note and raw-note inspection confirms exactly TWO compact upper gray-mark rows and mostly blank lower paper, with no third row or extra gray-mark cluster. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible interior holes, missing backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha viewing; near-opacity values were not used as a rejection shortcut, and no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: The source gray marks are indistinct visual shapes rather than readable text; the review verifies their two-row compact upper-paper footprint, not words. Fine source-scale hair and tiny spectacle hardware cannot be resolved microscopically at 65x67, but native raw viewing confirms no clear chin/jaw hair and one pair of round rims.
